title: ServePath SLI Skyline: route-level p50/p95/p99 with streaming vs non-streaming split
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Goal: build a production-ready dashboard (and underlying telemetry) that surfaces per-model and per-route latency SLI percentiles (p50/p95/p99) with an explicit split between streaming and non-streaming IO modes. The dashboard should enable engineers and SREs to quickly identify regressions that affect only streaming responses (token-emission latency) vs non-streaming responses (handler + model compute), and to trace anomalies to specific servepaths, kernels, or KV-cache behavior.

Scope:
- Instrumentation: add or validate trace hooks that mark request phases (ingest, route-resolve, model-queue, model-init, token-emit for streaming, finalize for sync). Ensure these span attributes propagate to sampled traces and to metrics.
- Metrics pipeline: create derived metrics in our metrics pipeline (Prometheus/StatsD -> Mimir -> metrics-catalog) for: servepath.latency.ms.p50/p95/p99 by {model, route, io_mode=streaming|sync} and servepath.token_emit.latency.ms.p50/p95/p99 for streaming-only requests. Add tags for runtime_variant and quantization_profile where available.
- Logs/Events: extend structured logs to include servepath_id, io_mode, convo_id, token_count, and model_variant so we can link failures and tails. Add log enrichment pipeline rule to index io_mode and servepath into our events store.
- Dashboard: design an interactive board with:
  * heatmap of p95 latency across routes (rows=model, columns=route) with colorbar and ability to toggle io_mode.
  * percentile time-series (p50/p95/p99) per route with streaming vs non-streaming stacked lines.
  * tail-sampler panel: top N slowest traces for selected route/io_mode with direct trace links.
  * cohort slicer: split by request-shape (prompt length, token_count, user_type) and by runtime_variant.
  * anomaly markers showing deploys, kernel changes, autoscaling events.
- Alerts: add p99 baseline alert per critical route (daily rolling window) with noisy suppression for low-volume routes.

Non-goals: global SLO definitions or billing-level dashboards (handled by separate initiative).

Implementation notes:
- Use existing trace attributes where possible; add new enum attribute io_mode with values [stream, sync] to be set by API gateway. For streaming, mark token emission latencies with span name token.emit and attribute emit_index.
- Metrics aggregation must be computed downstream in metrics system using histogram->percentile transforms; do not ship p95 computed in-app. Ensure we include exemplar trace IDs for each percentile bucket to enable drilldowns.
- Dashboard prototype will be built in the Console's Observability space (console-obs-boards) and should be parameterized by environment (prod/stage) and datacenter region.

Risks & mitigations:
- High-cardinality tags (model x route x runtime_variant x quant_profile) may increase metrics cardinality. Mitigation: apply cardinality caps and rollup tiers (model+route primary, variant rollups on-demand).
- Streaming traces are high-volume; enable adaptive sampling for token-level spans and ensure exemplar sampling for p99.

Deliverables:
1) New trace hook instrumentation PRs for API gateway and serving runtime.
2) Metrics pipeline transforms and metric definitions added to metrics-catalog.
3) Dashboard in Console with documented panels and runbook.
4) Alerting rules and on-call playbook updates.

Success criteria:
- Dashboard shows per-route p50/p95/p99 with io_mode toggle in prod for >90% of high-traffic routes.
- Engineers can jump from a p99 point to a representative trace within 10s.
- Alerting fires on injected synthetic regressions in stage and produces low false-positive rate in production after 1 week of tuning.
acceptance_criteria: Per-model/per-route p50/p95/p99 time-series available in Console for prod/stage with an io_mode filter (stream vs sync)
Exemplar trace IDs are attached to percentile metrics to enable trace drilldown from dashboard panels
Structured logs include io_mode and servepath_id for at least 95% of requests in prod
Token-emission spans for streaming requests are sampled and linked to p99 exemplars
Alerting rules (p99 breach) added for top 25 routes with documented suppression for low-volume routes
tasks: Add io_mode attribute to API gateway and propagate to context/trace
Instrument token.emit span in runtime and tag with emit_index and emit_latency_ms
Add metric definitions to metrics-catalog and request transforms in metrics pipeline team
Create dashboard panels (heatmap, percentile-series, tail-sampler, cohort slicer)
Add exemplar linking in metrics -> tracing integration
Run load test to validate metrics cardinality and adjust rollups
